svg.text: One panel per step. New parts in each picture are in colour; parts from earlier steps are grey. Hole = ROW/COL, as on docs/shield_holemap.svg. Pictures are renders of the INTENDED
If a CHECK fails, STOP - do not solder past it.
Remaining meter checks BEFORE any solder (shield OFF the Uno,
- Already done by Evan 2026-10-20: T and V beep to 5V; G and B beep to GND; G beeps to
- 0.1 U1/1 to U3/1: must BEEP (one strip, three holes)
- 0.2 V/12 to G/12 and V/12 to B/13: must be SILENT
- If either differs, STOP and send me the result.
TB6612 headers and carrier-top work (off the shield)
- Solder the two 8-pin headers to the carrier: SHORT ends up through the carrier, LONG
- Mark PWMA (label side) with a dot.
- On the carrier's top, solder insulated wire bridges between the pin tips: PWMA-PWMB,
AIN2-BIN2, AIN1-BIN1 (any thin wire), AO1-BO1 and AO2-BO2 (22 AWG).
- Solder C1 (470 uF): + lead to the VMOT tip, stripe (-) lead to the GND tip next to it
(bottom row, right end); stand the can UPRIGHT on the two tips, leads short (Evan
2026-10-21; was: lay it flat). Bend C2's leads out past the carrier's bottom edge,
low, so C2 sits beside the can, not under it.
- Solder C2 (0.1 uF) across the same VMOT and GND tips.
CHECK: meter: PWMA-PWMB, AIN1-BIN1, AIN2-BIN2, AO1-BO1, AO2-BO2 each BEEP; VMOT-GND
does NOT beep (C1 may chirp once)
- Chip up, dot at the top-left: top row pins into U2/1 ... U2/8, bottom row pins into
- Solder all 16 on the underside; trim the leftover pin length.
CHECK: U1/1 beeps to the PWMA pin; L3/7 beeps to VMOT; L3/1 beeps to L3/8 (GND
Bottom-side solder bridges (each joins exactly two neighbouring
- DANGER: P4/5 (GND) and P4/6 (+5V2) are neighbours - they must NOT touch.
- VBAT strips: L2/9-L2/10. Strip data: L3/12-P3/12, L3/13-P3/13.
- Uno 5V to the left field: V/1-V/0, V/0-V/-1, V/-1-L1/-1.
- DANGER: P3/-1 (+5V2) and P3/-2 (GND) are neighbours - must NOT touch.
CHECK: P4/5 to P4/6 SILENT; P3/-1 to P3/-2 SILENT; P4/6 beeps to P4/13; V/12 beeps to
- J5 (4 pins, pull out the 2nd pin) in L3/10, P3/10, P4/10, B/10. J6 (1 pin) in B/11.
CHECK: J5 top pin (L3/10) beeps to VMOT; J3 middle beeps to J4 middle (+5V2); J3
- R100k lying flat: leads into L1/9 and U3/9 only (body over G/9, V/9).
- R10k standing: U2/9 and U2/10. R2k standing: U3/10 and G/10.
- w1 L3/7 -> L3/9 (VMOT to the VBAT strip).
- w2 L3/8 -> B/8 (TB6612 GND to the star).
- w3 L3/2 -> V/0 (TB6612 VCC to the Uno 5V).
- w4 P4/7 -> P3/-1 (+5V2 to JP1's bottom pin).
- w5 B/2 -> P3/-2 (servo GND to the star).
CHECK: VBAT (L3/10) to B/10 SILENT; V/0 to B/2 SILENT; P4/7 to B/2 SILENT
Dupont wires to the Uno sockets (cut a male-male jumper, solder the
4x 200 ohm (2 in series per strip wire)
- L3/12 -> D4 and L3/13 -> D7, each with 200 + 200 ohm soldered in series IN the wire,
- Encoder yellow -> D2 socket, white -> D3 socket (male pins on the cable, not through
CHECK: with the shield on the Uno: each socket pin beeps to its hole; the Uno's 5V
- Re-run every SILENT check from steps 0, 3 and 6.
- Jumper on JP1's TOP two pins (servo on the Uno 5V).
- Pack OFF (rocker), Uno on the Pi's USB first; then rocker ON with nothing else
plugged in and meter VBAT at J5 (~8 V) and +5V2 at J3 middle (~5.0 V).
CHECK: VBAT ~ pack voltage, +5V2 ~ 5.0 V, Uno 5V ~ 5 V and NOT tied to +5V2 (V/12 to
P4/13 silent with the power off)
